title: Orange Vortex Pattern
description: A repeating pattern of bright oranges and orange slices with green leaves and small flowers arranged around a central dark swirling vortex on a deep navy blue background.
prompt: A seamless repeating pattern featuring whole oranges with stems and leaves, sliced oranges showing segments, and tiny white and pink flowers scattered across a deep navy blue background. In the center is a large dark swirling vortex with concentric rings. The style is vibrant flat digital illustration with bold outlines and rich saturated colors.
